note: Cases a conforming implementation must distinguish. Each states the input and the only conforming outcome.

cases.input: an interval no Filing Party observed, every party whose Filing Plan required the observation having declared the gap under C1 through C4
cases.expect: Unresolved: excluded from numerator and denominator; counted in the Unresolved Fraction; no fault recorded
cases.must_not: counted as delivered, or as not delivered, or a fault recorded against a party

cases.input: an interval a party's own Filing Plan required it to observe, and it neither observed nor declared under C1 through C4
cases.expect: attributed to that party under C3; J1 applies; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, read under 2.5.2 where no party observed
cases.must_not: treated as Unresolved with no fault recorded

cases.input: a measurement whose U/median exceeds the procedure's bound
cases.expect: no reading; a BoundaryRecord with cause instrument-failure
cases.must_not: a low reading, or evidence the field was below its floor

cases.input: the review deadline passes with no Counterparty Decision filed
cases.expect: terminal state expired, from the closing of the review window or the timeout at the Case deadline
cases.must_not: terminal state accepted, or expired derived from any other event

cases.input: L3 conforming and L7 non-conforming in one interval, both covered
cases.expect: the interval is not delivered
cases.must_not: delivered on the strength of the conforming layer

cases.input: a Profile naming L8 among the covered Layers
cases.expect: the Profile cannot be armed
cases.must_not: armed with L8 counting against the provider

cases.input: J1 selecting EF-02 where the required evidence class is operator-held
cases.expect: the selection is refused at arming time
cases.must_not: armed

cases.input: a Grade Class carrying a V4 field with no required evidence class
cases.expect: the Profile cannot be armed
cases.must_not: armed

cases.input: a Grade Class field left blank
cases.expect: the Grade Class is incomplete and cannot be armed
cases.must_not: read as not-material

cases.input: an MP-06 identity reading whose baseline was committed after the Window opened
cases.expect: the reading establishes nothing
cases.must_not: accepted as establishing identity

cases.input: a material Divergence under a Profile selecting DR-02, with the two figures inside the bound
cases.expect: the arithmetic mean governs the quantity; the terminal state comes from F2, or from I.1.1 where no decision is filed
cases.must_not: a terminal state derived from the resolution

cases.input: a record armed under version 1.0, read after a later version issues
cases.expect: conformance is assessed under version 1.0
cases.must_not: assessed under the later version

cases.input: no Filing Party observed; one required party declared the gap under C1 through C4, the other did not
cases.expect: the undeclared party bears the fault under J1; the declaring party bears none; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, under EF-04 or EF-05 excluded and counted in the Unresolved Fraction
cases.must_not: a fault recorded against the party that declared, or the interval read as Unresolved with no fault

cases.input: no Filing Party observed, both required to observe, neither declared
cases.expect: each party bears its own fault under J1; the value follows the Profile's Annex 2.5 selection, read under 2.5.2
cases.must_not: one fault shared between the parties, or no fault recorded

cases.input: the counterparty files an abstention under F2 and nothing else by the review deadline
cases.expect: the Case stays open until the deadline, then terminal state expired under I.1.1
cases.must_not: terminal state accepted, or a terminal state at the abstention

cases.input: a material Divergence under DR-03 whose three readings are 99.0, 99.5 and 100.0
cases.expect: the mean of all three, 99.5, governs the quantity

cases.input: F-01 over two Measured Subjects, one with zero eligible intervals and one with 100 eligible intervals, all conforming
cases.expect: no Period Figure; the evaluation returns requires-review naming eligible_interval_seconds_per_subject of the first subject; the Case proceeds under F2, or under I.1.1 where no Decision is filed
cases.must_not: a figure of 0 %, 50 % or 100 %, or a figure computed without the subject

cases.input: under EF-01, an interval no Filing Party observed, one required party having declared nothing, and no measurement covering it filed by W+30
cases.expect: from W+30 excluded from numerator and denominator and counted in the Unresolved Fraction, the fault recorded against the party C5.4 names; every later figure takes it so
cases.must_not: counted as delivered or as not delivered, or left suspended after W+30

cases.input: a Filing Party's first measurement of an interval, filed at W+35
cases.expect: enters the record marked late and is archived; no pass for the Window uses it
cases.must_not: used in any Period Figure for the Window

cases.input: under EF-03, an interval no Filing Party observed by W+2; the required party files a conforming measurement of it at W+20
cases.expect: the interval is valued from that measurement in the figure identified by W+30; the evidence fault under J1 stands
cases.must_not: the interval kept as not delivered in that figure, or the fault removed

cases.input: a Profile selecting MT-03 with F-01
cases.expect: the Profile cannot be armed
cases.must_not: armed

cases.input: a Profile selecting EF-07 and EF-03 for one obligation
cases.expect: the Profile cannot be armed
cases.must_not: armed

cases.input: a second credit Claim for the same obligation, adjusted Claim and pass, the first having ended rejected
cases.expect: the second credit Claim is not conforming; had the first ended withdrawn, the second would be admitted
cases.must_not: evaluated as a credit Claim, or a second credit for the same difference

cases.input: a Window with no Period Figure under 2.1.4 whose Case expires under EX-03
cases.expect: terminal state expired; EX-03 prices nothing; the record states that the amount is not computed under SQCD-1 and follows the agreement's terms identified under A7
cases.must_not: an amount computed under the remedy schedule, or terminal state accepted

cases.input: under a Profile selecting MT-02, a Filing Plan modification setting a sample interval other than the A3 sample interval
cases.expect: the modification is not conforming and does not take effect; the party files under the Plan in force
cases.must_not: the modification taking effect at the opening of the next Window

cases.input: F-01 and F-03 over one Measured Subject with 100 eligible intervals, all observed by both Filing Parties and all not delivered
cases.expect: Period Figure 0 % under each function, priced under the remedy schedule as any other figure
cases.must_not: no Period Figure, or requires-review under 2.1.4

cases.input: an interval Unresolved in the figure identified by W+30, and a first measurement of it filed at W+35
cases.expect: the measurement is archived; every figure for the Window keeps the interval Unresolved, with the same eligible denominator, fractions, materiality decision and conformance decision
cases.must_not: the interval moved to unilateral, or any fraction or decision changed

cases.input: a delivery Claim resting on the W+5 pass, whose remedy quote is $0; a Profile pass at W+20 with remedy quote $100, whose credit Claim ended accepted, or in a second branch expired under EX-03 with the $100 owed not yet paid; the figure identified by W+30 with remedy quote $150
cases.expect: in both branches the credit Claim on the W+30 figure is filed after the W+20 credit Claim is terminal, and its amount is $50
cases.must_not: $150, or $250 claimed across the two credit Claims

cases.input: F-05 with MT-01 at 1 %, the Profile naming the customer as reference party; the customer's Period Figure 99 hours and the provider's 100 hours at W+5
cases.expect: at W+5 the band is 0.99 hours and the Divergence of 1 hour is material; a Divergence Event is filed at W+5
cases.must_not: a band taken from the provider's figure, or a materiality decision waiting for the delivery Claim

cases.input: a settlement policy with an accept quorum of two; one valid accept within its grant, and nothing else, filed by the review deadline
cases.expect: terminal state expired under I.1.1 at the deadline
cases.must_not: terminal state accepted, or the Case left open after the deadline

cases.input: a Profile selecting MT-05 and naming no reference party; both Filing Parties' Period Figures 99.5 % at W+5
cases.expect: the Profile is armed; concordance under H3, and the equal value 99.5 % carries forward
cases.must_not: the Profile refused for want of a reference party, or a Divergence Event filed
